title: MOON: Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates for Multitask Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has demonstrated significant success in multi-task learning by mitigating task conflicts through gradient manipulation. However, most existing methods flatten model parameters into vectors and perform gradient manipulation under Euclidean geometry, thereby overlooking the matrix structure prevalent in modern architectures such as Transformers. In this paper, we show that gradient manipulation in Euclidean space does not generally yield the steepest descent direction under matrix geometry, potentially limiting optimization efficiency. Drawing from the theory of steepest descent for matrix-valued parameters, we propose MOON (Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates), which performs gradient manipulation under spectral--nuclear norm geometry and uses the orthonormalized manipulated gradient for parameter updates. translated_title: MOON：多任务学习的多目标正交归一化更新
translated_abstract: 多目标优化（MOO）通过梯度操作缓解任务冲突，在多任务学习中取得了显著成功。然而，现有大多数方法将模型参数展平为向量，并在欧几里得几何下进行梯度操作，从而忽视了现代架构（如Transformer）中普遍存在的矩阵结构。在本文中，我们表明欧几里得空间中的梯度操作在矩阵几何下通常不产生最陡下降方向，这可能限制优化效率。基于矩阵值参数的最陡下降理论，我们提出了MOON（多目标正交归一化更新），该方法在谱-核范数几何下进行梯度操作，并使用正交归一化后的操纵梯度进行参数更新。理论上，对于光滑非凸目标，我们建立了平均帕累托迭代的收敛性。
tldr: 本文提出MOON方法，通过谱-核范数几何下的正交归一化梯度更新，解决了多任务学习中欧几里得梯度操作忽略矩阵结构导致的优化效率问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MOON, which performs orthonormalized gradient updates under spectral-nuclear norm geometry to address optimization inefficiency caused by Euclidean gradient manipulation overlooking matrix structures in multitask learning.
